unresolved_consumer_findings.issue: Current C70 Principal/v1 directly binds the C65 Definition. PrincipalReference,AuthorityClaim,Delegation and four subject contracts bind their own exact meanings. Type admission does not accept this formalization or create the candidate Principal fixtures.

Definition/v1 shape and pure projections accept hypothetical prose inferring Person identity/rights from Principal identity,issuer authenticity from labels,current grants from period text and authorization from scope. These are shape observations,not full validator admission or real authority.

Principal/v1 payload has principal kind,stable subject,recognition-boundary list,registry and status,while its boundary list can be empty. Source-governed identity/exact issuer/boundary recognition maps are absent;closed shape alone does not authenticate recognition.

PrincipalReference/v1 has issuer,resolution route and integrity strings. Whole fixtures accept foreign Principal/issuer/route and non-hash integrity tokens without actual resolution. Its Principal reference and the Principal/subject fixtures do not form one joined identity instance.

AuthorityClaim/v1 records claimant,basis,decision scope,permissions and limitations;Delegation records delegator/eligible agent,scope/actions,policies/gates,period,revocation and redelegation. These independently admitted shapes do not prove an exact current grant applicable to a nominated Principal/scope/time.

Person,PersonReference,Team and AgentInstance retain separate identity,lifecycle,privacy,membership and accountability structures. Before/after preservation and no identity/authority merge require accepted subject and Principal representation maps rather than equal reference labels.

C70 exact authorization/bundle/proposal and zero runtime/consumer/typed-relation activation are preserved. Its only ordinary instance is the integrated Governed Model;no Principal fixture or authorization is admitted by reading the current registry. Local review/integrated-model bytes remain source evidence,not runtime activation.

Seventeen independent Principal-only T/I models retain inclusive recognition,issuer independence,subject kind change,optional nonconsequential grants and strict consequential-current/scope guards. Shared meanings,real issuer/grant validity,source precedence and accepted carrier maps remain pending.
